mapper.insert: INSERT INTO core_idempotency_record (context_key, operation_code, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, response_code, locked_until, expires_at) VALUES (#{contextKey}, #{operation}, #{key}, #{hash}, 'PROCESSING', #{claim}, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM core_event_outbox WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM core_idempotency_record WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM flow_instance WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE

SELECT c.id FROM core_idempotency_record c JOIN core_event_outbox e ON e.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.response_json, '$.outboxId')) AS UNSIGNED) JOIN flow_instance f ON f.id = CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.payload_json, '$.flowInstanceId')) AS UNSIGNED) WHERE e.aggregate_type = 'BUSINESS_ACTION' AND e.event_type = 'BUSINESS_ACTION_APPROVAL_REQUESTED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.response_json, '$.status')) = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND f.status IN ('COMPLETED','REJECTED','WITHDRAWN','TERMINATED','RETURNED') ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 50
